title: Inventory a docker-compose file without inventing versions
prompt: Add what runs in docker-compose.yml to unpatched.yml so it can be watched. Only add things whose version you can read from the file. Tell me what you left out and why.

files.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  nextcloud:
    image: nextcloud:29.0.3
    ports: ["443:443"]
  cache:
    image: redis:latest
  blog:
    image: ghcr.io/example/blog:stable
